_readme: Enemy move.style is one of march, shuffle, swagger, dance, zigzag, stomp, pace, strafe, sneak, waddle, scurry, stumble. All gameplay tuning lives here and in config/levels/*.json. Distances in metres, times in seconds. Level x positions are normalised -1..1 across the street.

dev._readme: button: show the DEV button on the HUD while playing (power-ups, enemies, skipping, speed...). Development only: it and the tuning panel (five taps on the version number, or ?debug) exist only when the game is run from the dev server (npm run dev) on the development machine. They are left out of every built copy: the web build and the phone apps (main.js).

ui._readme: Enemies with at least healthBarMinHp hit points get a health bar; it appears once they are within healthBarDist metres or have been hit.

turns._readme: Intersections. A level lists them as "turns": [{"z": 255}] (metres along the level). The player turns the way of whichever half of the road he walks in on. width: how long the junction is. clear: nothing is placed this many metres before one. landing: nor within this many metres after it (the player comes out 9 m past the junction). promptFrom: how far out the two-way prompt and the coloured lanes start. slowTime / slowScale: the dip into slow motion as they appear (seconds, speed). swing / swingTime / settleTime: the camera move (radians, seconds into the cut, seconds out of it). branches: false makes both ways the same; otherwise one side is 'quiet' (every quietCut-th enemy removed) and the other 'loot' (every lootEnemyEvery-th enemy doubled, a power-up every lootPickupEvery metres, and a heart), dealt at random each run.

backSlap._readme: Backslap power-up: every ordinary slap swings back the other way for a second hit on the same faces. duration: seconds. timeMult: how much longer the there-and-back swing takes than a plain slap. returnDamage: the backhand's damage as a multiple of the slap's (1 = the pair does double).

movingPickups._readme: From level fromLevel on, power-ups (Golden Hand, Double, Smash, Hyper) slide down the street toward the player instead of waiting. Now and then (trainChance) one placed in a level arrives as a train of train[0]..train[1] of them, gap metres apart, each laneStep metres to the side of the last, so the player has to weave. A lone one may weave by itself (weaveChance, weaveWidth metres, weaveRate). speed: metres per second toward the player. catchRadius: how close counts as caught. A level spawn can override with "moving": true/false and "train": n.

powerups._readme: Where the power-ups (glove, double, smash, hyper, back, buddy, noodle) placed in a level actually turn up, dealt fresh every run. minGap: never two within this many metres of each other (a later one is pushed back, or dropped if that runs past the end). jitter: each is moved up to this many metres either way. From level randomFrom on, each spot gets a random kind by weights, never the same kind twice in a row (noRepeat). A level spawn with "fixed": true is left exactly as placed.

stacking._readme: Catching a power-up you already hold stacks it. maxStack: Golden Hand and Double Slap can hold this many lots of their time. maxCharges: how many Smash or Hyper slaps can be queued (they go off one after another). holdDouble: Double Slap's clock stops while the Golden Hand is out.

photoFace._readme: A face from the player's own photo, worn by some of the tough enemies. types: who can wear it. everyElite: when there is at least one face, every tough one wears one (a face can then be on more than one enemy at a time if needed; chance and maxAtOnce only apply when this is false). chance: how many of them do, after the first one of a level (which always does). maxAtOnce: how many enemies can wear the same face at once. maxFaces: how many faces the player can keep (they take turns). The checks on the photo: minScore (how sure the detector must be that it is a face), minFaceFrac (face size as a share of the picture), maxTurn / maxTilt (how far off straight-on), minSharp (blur), genderSure (how sure it must be of male / female before it stops asking the player). style: cel (redrawn like the painted faces) | photo (pasted on as it is). shade: how strong the shadow tones are. ink: how dark the inked lines are. lines: how many fine lines are picked up (0 = only the big dark shapes). beard: keep beards, moustaches and stubble. beard3d: give a thick beard some body on the chin. beardMin: how much of a part of the face must look hairy before it is believed (raise it if shadows turn into beards, lower it if light beards are missed).

cine._readme: Cinematics. The conversations themselves are in config/scenes.json.

lava._readme: Lava pools, placed per level with lava: [{z, len, x0, x1}]. damage = player HP lost on stepping in, then again every tick seconds while still in it. playerGrace = metres of the edge the player can stand on safely. enemyDamage = the same for enemies (every tick); escapeSpeed = how fast a burning enemy scrambles out. Enemies steer round pools avoidLook metres ahead, keeping avoidMargin clear of the edge. A slap that lands within tumbleReach metres of a pool knocks the enemy into it. bubbles = sparks per second near the player.

bricks._readme: Toy bricks scattered on the floor (level hazards with kind "bricks"): they hurt like lava. damage = player HP lost on stepping in, then again every tick seconds while still in it; enemyDamage = the same for enemies; escapeSpeed = how fast a hurt enemy hops out. density = bricks per square metre (looks only). Enemies steer round them like lava (lava.avoid*).

wet._readme: Wet floor (level hazards with kind "wet"): no damage, but an enemy slapped while standing in it slips and skids slide metres back on their back (at up to slideSpeed m/s), out of the fight for slipTime seconds. Anyone they skid into goes over too (bowlDamage, then skids bowlPush metres): two is BOWLED OVER, three or more is a STRIKE worth strikeBonus x the combo multiplier. playerGrip: how well the player's steering bites on a wet floor (1 = as normal).

cream._readme: Custard pie splattered on the track (level hazards with kind "cream"): works exactly like a wet floor (see wet), it just looks like pie.

tramp._readme: Trampolines (level hazards with kind "tramp", round: x0..x1 sets the size). Step on one and you are thrown length metres forward and height metres up over time seconds, safe in the air; landing hits every enemy within radius metres for damage (bossDamage for a boss). enemy: enemies use them too. A share of them (chance) steer onto one within look metres ahead and reach metres to the side; walking on, one is thrown up to length metres toward the player (height high, time seconds) and lands on a marked spot, hurting the player for damage if he is within radius; slapped back onto one, he is thrown knockLength metres away and takes knockDamage on landing.

coffee._readme: Scalding coffee (The Manager's slam spills it): burns like lava. damage = player HP lost on stepping in, then again every tick seconds while still in it; enemyDamage / escapeSpeed = the same for enemies. color / rim / foam: how it looks.

belt._readme: Moving walkways (level hazards with kind "belt", dir 1 or -1): anyone standing on one is carried speed m/s along the level (the player is never carried on into an enemy in the way). arrow / light: the arrows on the belt and the strip of light along its sides.

ice._readme: Ice on the piste (level hazards with kind "ice"; The Yeti's slam freezes more of it): works exactly like a wet floor (see wet), it just looks like ice.

ramp._readme: Kicker ramps (level hazards with kind "ramp", round: x0..x1 sets the size): a snow jump. It throws the player exactly as a trampoline does (see tramp for the flight and the landing); only the look and the words differ.

avalanche._readme: Avalanches (level "avalanches": [{ z, side }], side -1 left, 1 right, 0 = whichever half the player is on; ski.js). When the player reaches z, that half of the piste is marked for warn seconds, then the snow comes down it from `from` metres behind at speed m/s and runs `ahead` metres on. Caught in it: damage to the player; an enemy is buried (the player's knockout) for bonus points times the multiplier.
avalanche.sub: the red side is about to be buried

oil._readme: Crude oil on the road (level hazards with kind "oil"; The Sultan's slam strikes more of it): works exactly like a wet floor (see wet: the player's feet skate, and an enemy slapped while standing in it skids away on their back and bowls over whoever is behind), it just looks like oil. damp / color / sheen: the stain round it, the oil, the rainbow on top. words: what pops up the first time the player steps in each patch.

jars._readme: Enemies hiding in great jars in the road (a level spawn with "jar": true), or in a snowman ("jar": "snowman", which uses snowWords). The lid rattles once the player is within rattleFrom metres; at a distance between the two trigger values the jar bursts and out they come, dazed for stun seconds. Nobody can touch them while they are inside.

tape._readme: Red tape (level hazards with kind "tape"; The Overruler's gavel slams more out of the road): no damage, but the player is held up while on it. slow = share of the usual speed, grip = how well the steering bites (1 = as normal). words: what pops up on stepping in. Enemies are never slowed by it (they wrote the rules).

difficulty._readme: The difficulty curve. It belongs to a level's PLACE in the running order (the "levels" list above), not to the level: whatever is played first is the gentlest. Each list has one entry per place; a list shorter than the number of levels repeats its last entry. windup: every enemy's (and boss's) wind-up time is multiplied by this, so early on there is longer to see a slap coming. attackers: how many enemies may wind up at once (bosses not counted). mercy: with lowHp hearts or fewer left, a knockout may shake a heart loose: chance per knockout at each place, bigChance for the large ones (the slow-motion finishers), at most one every cooldown seconds and never while one is already lying on the road. secondWind: lose the same level `after` times running and it starts with an extra heart, up to `max` extra; beating it clears the count. tools/difficulty-bot.js measures the curve (see the README).

boss._readme: Rules every boss shares (enemy.js updateBoss); each boss's own entry under enemies has the rest. The fight is in rounds: phases of them (a boss can set its own "phases"), each a share of its health. phaseSpeed: how much faster the boss works in each round. patterns (per boss): one list of attacks per round, picked from at random: slam (one side or the middle, in red: slide out of it), onetwo (a slam, then at once a second where the player went: chainWindup of the usual wind-up), stomp (the whole width in orange but only stompReach of the usual reach: back off; stompWindup times the usual wind-up). Dodge an attack and the boss is OPEN: it takes openStun seconds longer to recover, and until then (plus openTime) every slap does openMult times the damage. Between rounds it reels for breakTime seconds (open throughout), everyone it had called in is blown away, a heart drops, and then it calls summonCount of its "summon" (lastRoundExtra more in the last round).

coach._readme: Tips (game.js coach): the first time the thing happens in a run, time dips for `slow` seconds (to `scale` speed) and the tip goes up. levels: only on the first this-many levels (after that the player knows). dodge = an enemy winds up; boss = a boss winds up; open = a boss is left open; stomp = a boss stomps; moves = the first time enemies close in (the Rising Slap).

boss.sub: make it miss and it is wide open

moves.sub: swipe it in one go (or ← ↓ ↙) · as often as you like

ski.sub: push up to tuck · pull down to brake · slide to carve

newFaces._readme: The first time ever the player meets a kind of enemy listed here, a card goes up with its name and this line (game.js meet). Once per kind, for good (kept in the save). every: at least this many seconds between cards. enabled: false turns them off.

lines.suit: Doesn't flinch when slapped. Pull back when he winds up.
lines.runner: Fast and jumpy. Meet them head on.
lines.biker: Comes in fast. Slap them off the bike.
lines.scooter: Swoops from side to side. Slap them off it.
lines.skater: Comes in fast and low. Slap them off the board.
lines.busker: Strums until you get close. Then the guitar comes out.
lines.bboy: Dances round you. Line them up before they do.
lines.bouncer: Big, slow, hits for 2. Finish him for a bonus.
lines.picketer: The sign soaks up slaps. A POWER SLAP cracks it faster.
lines.tagger: Throws down the lit lane. Slide aside.
lines.mime: Dodges your first slap. The next one lands.
lines.doll: Knock her out and two little ones pop out.
lines.bucket: Bursts when knocked out and slaps everyone nearby.
lines.og: Never swings first, always swings back. Slap, then step away.
lines.twin: Floor one and the other pulls them up. Floor both.
lines.slugger: A wide swing that hits for 2. Back right off.
lines.oldschool: Two swings, one after the other. Wait for both.
lines.farmhand: A wide swing that hits for 2. Back right off.
lines.rancher: Two swings, one after the other. Wait for both.
lines.stripes: Whistles for backup. Shut him up first.
lines.grip: Grabs and holds. Wiggle or slap your way free.
lines.hoops: Lobs onto the red circle. Step out of it.
lines.potato: Takes a lot of slapping. Slow as a sofa.
lines.grilldad: Lobs burgers onto the red circle. Step out of it.
lines.auntie: Throws slippers down the lit lane. Slide aside.
lines.clown: Pies down the lit lane. One in the face and you can't see.
lines.juggler: Lobs pins onto the red circle. Step out of it.
lines.strongman: A wide swing that hits for 2. Back right off.
lines.acrobat: Flips out of the way of your first slap.
lines.mallcop: Rides in and grabs. Wiggle or slap your way free.
lines.kiosk: Free samples down the lit lane. Slide aside.
lines.walker: Quick hands. Don't stand in front of them.
lines.shopaholic: Her bags soak up slaps until they split.
lines.senator: His hot air blows you back. Slap him to shut him up.
lines.judge: Lobs gavels onto the red circle. Step out of it.
lines.lobbyist: The briefcase soaks up slaps. A POWER SLAP cracks it faster.
lines.intern: One slap does it. Mind the coffee they drop.
lines.agent: Grabs and holds. Wiggle or slap your way free.
lines.spin: Spins out of your first slap. The next one lands.
lines.candidate: The poll climbs while they're left alone. At 100% they are elected: bigger, tougher.
lines.canvasser: Leaflets down the lit lane, and pushes candidates' polls up.
lines.bureaucrat: Rubber stamps down the lit lane. Slide aside.
lines.thief: One slap does it. Watch the jars: the lids rattle.
lines.tycoon: Throws money down the lit lane. Slide aside.
lines.spicer: Lobs spice onto the red circle. One sniff and you can't see.
lines.charmer: Throws a cobra down the lit lane. Slide aside.
lines.rider: Swoops in on a flying carpet. Slap them off it.
lines.haggler: His best carpet soaks up slaps. A POWER SLAP cracks it faster.
lines.guard: A fan as wide as the road, and it hits for 2. Back right off.
lines.genie: Three wishes, all for itself: knock it out and it wishes itself back. Twice.
lines.boarder: Carves in fast from side to side. Slap them off the board.
lines.snowballer: Snowballs down the lit lane. One in the face and you can't see.
lines.instructor: Whistles up the ski school. Shut him up first.
lines.patrol: Rides in and grabs. Wiggle or slap your way free.
lines.apres: Lobs the whole fondue onto the red circle. Step out of it.
lines.skibro: Swings his skis like a club: wide, and it hits for 2. Back right off.

tips._readme: Advice on the result screen. After a loss: the line for whatever took the most hearts (melee = an enemy's slap, thrown = something thrown or lobbed, floor = lava, bricks and the like, boss), or any. After a win with fewer than three stars: stars, with {n} = the share of faces the next star takes and {s} = that many stars.
tips.melee: Red on the ground means a slap is coming. Pull back or slide aside, then slap them while they recover.
tips.thrown: Thrown things fly straight down the lit lane, lobbed ones land on the red circle. Slide out from under them.
tips.floor: Mind the floor! Lava, bricks and hot coffee hurt every second you stand in them. Enemies too: knock them in.
tips.boss: Slide out of the red (back off from the orange). A boss that misses is WIDE OPEN: every slap counts double.
tips.any: Pull back when you see red. Fill the FRENZY meter, tap it, then mash.

rally._readme: Slapdash's protesters (level "rallies": [[z, side]], rally.js). The next crowd up the avenue (within hear metres) leads a chant every every seconds (give or take a fifth); a bully knocked out within cheerRange metres of a crowd gets a cheer, worth hype frenzy points per knockout; a candidate within booRange metres of a crowd gets booed (game.json candidate campaign.booMult), a BOOO every booEvery seconds. exciteTime: how long a crowd keeps jumping.
chants: HEY HEY, HO HO, BILL 404 HAS GOT TO GO!
WHAT DO WE WANT? SLAPS! WHEN? NOW!

motorcade._readme: Crossroads in Slapdash (level "crossroads"). The lights at each one start cycling once the player is within wake metres: green (WALK) for firstGreen (then green) seconds, amber for amber seconds (sirens; the motorcade comes down the cross street at speed m/s and reaches the avenue just as it turns red), then red until it has gone through. Anyone in its lane is run over: the player loses damage HP and is thrown back to the kerb; an enemy is knocked out (it counts as the player's knockout, plus bonus points times the combo multiplier). warnFrom: how close the player must be for the MOTORCADE! banner the first time.

decor._readme: Decoration only, no effect on play. rats = how many can be out at once (0 = none, max 8).

frenzy._readme: Fill the meter by fighting, press the button, then mash. The number of taps reached in mashTime decides the tier. combo.frenzyEvery > 0 also brings back the old automatic frenzy.

combo._readme: window: seconds a combo survives without a hit. Every multiplierStep hits the score multiplier goes up one (to maxMultiplier). power: every `every`-th slap of a combo is a POWER SLAP: `damage` extra, `shield` off a guard instead of 1, the whole reaction `impact` times as hard, a freeze frame (feel.freeze.power) followed by `hitstop` times the usual pause, a shake `shake` times the usual, and the hand swells to `hand` times its size on the way in. Keep every equal to multiplierStep so the power slap is the one that bumps the multiplier. heatAt / heatFall: the music follows the combo (game.js sound): heatAt slaps in a row bring in nearly the whole band, and it dies away again at heatFall per second.

trail._readme: The glowing streak behind the hand: time = how many seconds of its path it shows, width = metres across at the hand, color = the tail colour (it is white-hot at the hand).

spaghettiArms._readme: SPAGHETTI ARMS power-up (noodle.js): the arms turn into long wobbly noodles. duration: seconds per pickup (stacks like the other timed ones). rangeMult / arcMult: how much further ahead / wider than an ordinary slap the hands reach (the Golden Hand does not add to it: the longer reach wins). idleLen: how long the floppy arms hang, in ordinary arm lengths. In a slap the noodle stretches exactly as far as the face it is slapping, so rangeMult alone decides how far that can be. snap: how fast it springs back afterwards. wobble / wobbleRate: how much and how fast it wiggles. drag: how far the swing bends it back. look: noodle colour and thickness.

smackBuddy._readme: SMACK BUDDY power-up (buddy.js): a friend vaults in and fights beside the player. duration: seconds per pickup; catching more adds the same again, up to maxTime. He keeps side metres to one side of the player, goes for whoever is closest within range metres ahead (or whoever has hold of the player), runs at speed m/s and slaps every interval seconds when within reach metres of their face, for damage (bossDamage on a boss). slapTime: one swing. hype: his hits fill the frenzy meter this much of a player hit. warnTime: he flickers for the last seconds. enterTime: the vault in. Enemies fight him just as they fight the player: one goes for him when he is closer than the player by more than aggro metres. He has hp hits in him (a fresh pickup heals him), is untouchable for invuln seconds after a hit and reels for stun seconds; out of hearts he is knocked out and leaves early. look: how he looks. lines: what he shouts.

koSurge._readme: A knockout carries the player forward: for time seconds (fading) the run is up to speed times faster and the view opens by fov degrees.

freeze._readme: Freeze frames: the whole scene is held exactly as it was when the hand landed (fighters, camera, sparks; the comic word slams in over it), for this many seconds. power = a power slap (every fourth slap of a combo); ko = any knockout blow; big = a knockout of a large enemy (before its slow-motion launch); boss = the blow that floors a boss. frenzy: in a frenzy they are this fraction as long, so it keeps its pace. At 60 frames a second 0.1 is six frames. The hitstop values below are the softer pause that follows: the fight stays stopped but the effects play.

feel._hitPushBack: A slap that does not floor them knocks the enemy hitPushBack metres back up the street (at hitPushSpeed m/s; a quarter of that per Hyper Slap hit). Bosses stand their ground. A lava pool within lava.tumbleReach behind them catches them.

impact._readme: The rest of a slap's reaction (enemy.js slapped/updateFace, game.js cheekFx). power: how hard each kind of hand is; everything below is multiplied by it (koMult more on a knockout). The head reacts in a chain, each a spring (Stiff = how fast, Damp = how soon it settles, lower swings more): roll = the head tilts toward the shoulder (rollFollow: and keeps tilting with the turn), neck = it kinks sideways, chin = it flips up, flail = both arms fly out. lines: size of the manga impact lines. streak: the motion lines behind the head. sweat / tears (tearChance) / dust / sauce (Spaghetti Arms) / gold (Golden Hand): how many particles. dizzyBelow: stars circle the head while health is at or under this share (dizzyTime seconds, dizzyStars stars, dizzySpin rad/s). camKick / camPush / camRoll: how hard the camera is knocked sideways, pushed in and rolled. nod: how far the player's own head goes into a slap; look: how far it turns to watch the face (radians). particleSize / dustSize: every slap particle / dust cloud is this size times its usual. spread: how far slap particles stray from the slap's direction (under 1, so none ever flies back toward the hand).

cheek._readme: How a slapped face reacts. snap/whip: how far the head is already turned on the hit frame, and how hard it whips on. whipStiff/whipDamp: the neck spring (lower damp = more swings back and forth). jiggle*: the flesh wobble. smushTime: how long the slapped face is held. swellPerHit/swellSize: the lump on the cheek. coolTime: seconds for the handprint to fade from fresh to old. spinDamage: hits this heavy still spin the head all the way round.

haptics._readme: impact: LIGHT|MEDIUM|HEAVY (native tick). ms: vibration length (used on web, and on native when no impact is set).

floorSlam._readme: His slam kicks a toy box over: that stretch of floor is covered in bricks for life seconds (len metres long, width = share of the struck zone). chance per slam, chanceEnraged after the first round; never more than max at once.

The crack of his whip sets the sawdust alight: a burning patch for life seconds (len metres long, width = share of the struck zone). chance per slam, chanceEnraged after the first round; never more than max at once.

He slams his coffee down: a scalding puddle (burns like lava) for life seconds (len metres long, width = share of the struck zone). chance per slam, chanceEnraged after the first round; never more than max at once.

filibuster._readme: The filibuster: once the player is between minRange and range metres away (and within width across), he takes the floor for time seconds, a new line every every seconds, and the hot air blows the player back push m/s (holding forward still gains ground, slowly). A slap cuts him off (yield lines); after that he waits cooldown seconds before starting again.
open: I'd like to read the entire bill.
words: Let me read you my grocery list.
Now, a short story. Very long.

spillOnKo._readme: Knocked out, the intern drops the coffee run: a scalding puddle (game.json coffee) width metres wide (half), len long, for life seconds.

campaign._readme: Running for office: a poll number over the head starts at start (plus up to spread) per cent and climbs rate per cent a second while the candidate is in the fight (within activateDist) and not reeling; shakeMult times faster while shaking the player's hand (the grab); plus helpRate for every helper (canvasser) within helpRange metres; times booMult while protesters boo (game.json rally). Each slap takes drop off. At 100 they are ELECTED: grow times the size, healed, speed times faster, and a mandate that soaks up mandate slaps. Knocked out before that, they concede: bonus points times the combo multiplier.
won: The people have spoken! (Me. I spoke.)

floorSlam._readme: His gavel comes down and the paperwork flies: a tangle of red tape on the road (game.json tape) for life seconds (len metres long, width = share of the struck zone). chance per slam, chanceEnraged after the first round; never more than max at once. word: what pops up.

lavaSlam._readme: His slam cracks the road: that stretch turns to lava for life seconds (len metres long, width = share of the struck zone). chance per slam, chanceEnraged after the first round; never more than max pools at once.

wishes._readme: Three wishes, and it spends them on itself: knocked out with wishes left, it is whole again (full health) and somewhere else in a puff of smoke, back metres further up the road, out of reach for stun seconds. count: how many times. Only when the wishes are gone does a knockout count.

floorSlam._readme: His sceptre comes down and strikes oil: a slick on the road (game.json oil: slippery, like a wet floor) for life seconds (len metres long, width = share of the struck zone). chance per slam, chanceEnraged after the first round; never more than max at once. word: what pops up.

Its fists come down and the piste freezes over: a sheet of ice (game.json ice: slippery, like a wet floor) for life seconds (len metres long, width = share of the struck zone). chance per slam, chanceEnraged after the first round; never more than max at once.

moves._readme: Special moves drawn with the thumb (moves.js). on: false turns them off. charge: every move costs charge (the bolts under the hearts): max bolts, start = how many a level starts with, perPower / perFinisher = earned by a power slap (every fourth slap of a combo; 0.5 = two of them to a bolt) and by flooring a large enemy. input: how the thumb is read. seg = the length of one segment of its path, as a fraction of the screen's shorter side; min = a stroke must be at least this many segments, and the whole motion at least len; stray = a wobble shorter than this between two strokes is forgiven; window = seconds a whole motion may take; pause = the thumb resting this long starts afresh; hold = an arc waits this long to see whether it is turning into a circle; lockout = seconds after a move before another is read; circleTurns = eighths of a turn that make a circle (8 = all the way round), inside circleWindow seconds. list: the moves, tried in this order. motions = the shapes that do it, as strokes on the number pad (8 up the screen, 2 down, 4 left, 6 right, 7 9 1 3 the diagonals). In a stroke the digits before ~ are the ways it may head as a whole (within slack radians) and those after are ways it may wobble through; :2 = at least that many segments; a final ? = may be left out. Or "circle". show / hint = what the pause screen says. cost in bolts (0 = free, as often as he likes); recover = seconds after it before he can slap again; window / slack = its own time limit and tolerance for the drawing; time = how long it lasts; hitAt = when it lands; root = feet planted meanwhile; safe = seconds from its start that nothing can hurt him (default: all of it; the Rising Slap is safe on the way up and open on the way down). damage / bossDamage; crack = how much of a guard each hit takes; impact = how hard the hit looks; bonus = points per enemy when it catches `crowd` or more. rising: radius, height and spins of the jump, lunge = metres it carries him forward over lungeTime seconds (it hits whoever it reaches on the way, so its reach ahead is radius + lunge), koUp = how much higher than usual a knockout flies, launch = what happens to whoever survives it (thrown height up for time seconds, back and side metres away, damage on landing). wave (the fireball): hitAt = how long it is gathered between his hands before it is let go, speed, range, width (half, what it hits), size (of the ball), flame = its colours [core, hot, flame, deep] unless another is picked in the trophy room, farShot = metres flown for a knockout to count as a long shot. cyclone: radius, tick = seconds between hits, push = metres each hit shoves them, spin = radians a second; noodle = what it becomes while Spaghetti Arms are out: its name, len = how long the spin flings the noodles (in ordinary arm lengths), radius = how far it then reaches, trail = how hard they are dragged round behind, sauce = the colours flung about.
moves.title: SPECIAL MOVES
moves.how: Draw the shape quickly with your thumb, anywhere, without lifting it. The Rising Slap is free. Combos earn ⚡ for the others: every 4th slap is half a bolt, a finisher a whole one.

rising.name: RISING SLAP
rising.hint: or ← ↓ ↙. Free. Hits everyone near you and breaks any guard

wave.name: SLAP WAVE

audio._readme: Volumes, 0..1 and up. master: everything. music: the band. sfx: slaps, voices and everything else that happens. ambience: the place itself (wind, traffic, crickets), on top of sfx. reverb: how much the room answers back (1 = as each level sets it, 0 = dry). Everything is mixed through a limiter in audio.js, so turning one thing up never makes the whole distort; the balance between individual effects is the LEVEL table there.
